task_description: Implements a variant of the Dutch National Flag problem for array element separation, partitioning non-negative elements from strictly negative elements. Uses a two-pointer algorithm to rearrange the array in-place, ensuring the resulting sequence is a permutation of the original array, with the first part containing all non-negative elements and the second part containing all strictly negative elements.
